Definition: to break away (from just authority), i.e. trespass, apostatize, quarrel
BiblicalUsage: 1) to rebel, transgress, revolt; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to rebel, revolt; 1a2) to transgress; 1b) (Niphal) to be rebelled against
